lines.text: What do you think, not how!
Many learners say: How do you think about it?
Better: What do you think about it?
What! What do you think about my idea?

data.wrong: How do you think about it?
data.right: What do you think about it?

quiz.stem: ___ do you think about my idea?

native.tip: 中文说“你怎么想”，很多人就直译成 How do you think。英语问别人的看法要说 What do you think。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “How do you think about it?”😅 中文说“怎么想”，英语要用 what：“What do you think about it?”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“What do you think about it?”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: A word-for-word translation gives how, but English asks what do you think.
en.caption: Do you say “How do you think about it?” 😅 English asks with what: “What do you think about it?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
